en.headline: Yuen Long district councillor jailed 2.5 years for sex with 13-year-old
en.dek: District Court judge notes lack of remorse in sentencing Sei Chun-hing over an offence from more than a decade ago; he was acquitted of a related indecent-assault count.
body: Yuen Long District Councillor Sei Chun-hing was sentenced on Tuesday to two years and six months in prison after being convicted of unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under 16.

District Judge Stanley Chan Kwong-chi passed sentence at the District Court. The offence involved the girl, then 13, in a Tin Shui Wai flat in 2011. A separate charge of indecent assault involving the same complainant when she was 11 was dismissed after trial.

The judge noted that Sei had shown no remorse and that sexual offences against young people required deterrent sentences. Sei, a member of the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong, was elected to the district council in 2023. The maximum penalty for the offence is five years.

zh.headline: 元朗區議員施振興因與13歲女童發生性行為判囚兩年半
zh.dek: 區域法院法官指被告缺乏悔意；事件發生於十多年前，另控非禮則被裁定罪名不成立。
body: 元朗區議員施振興周二被判處監禁兩年六個月，他早前被裁定與一名未滿16歲女童發生非法性行為罪名成立。
區域法院法官陳廣池作出判決。控罪指事件於2011年在天水圍一個單位發生，當時女童13歲。另一項指他在女童11歲時非禮的控罪，經審訊後被裁定罪名不成立。
法官表示被告沒有表現悔意，涉及幼童的性罪行必須以阻嚇性刑罰處理。施振興屬民建聯成員，於2023年當選區議員。有關罪行最高可判監禁五年。
